name: Diff
description: Shows the changes between two versions of a text, unified or side by side, with hunks of context around each change and the changed words marked. Every stack computes the same diff, so there is no diff library and no script. The header mirrors in RTL; the code stays LTR.

livewire.name: diff
capabilities: Rendered on the server, with no script
The actions slot holds header controls, such as a Clipboard or a view switch bound with wire:model.live
2.x old and new still work, as oldContent and newContent

vue.name: Diff
capabilities: The actions slot holds header controls

props.name: fileName
props.description: What changed, at the start of the header: a file path or "Version 3 → Version 4".

props.name: view
props.description: One column with both line numbers, or the old version beside the new one, deletions paired with additions. Emitted as data-view.

props.name: wordLevel
props.description: Marks the changed words inside a changed line, in ins and del, when the old and new line share some words. Best for short edits.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Changes further apart than twice this start a new hunk.

props.name: countsLabel
props.description: The counts' text for assistive technology; {additions} and {deletions} are filled in. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( '{additions} additions, {deletions} deletions' ).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in the table when the versions are the same. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'No changes' ).

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as a copy button or a Tabs view switch.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { header: '…', code: '…' }.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The icon, file name, counts and actions. Mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: A compare icon. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: file
parts.description: The file name, in the mono font.

parts.name: counts
parts.description: +additions and −deletions in success and error text, with countsLabel as hidden text.

parts.name: hunk
parts.description: A hunk header (@@ -a,b +c,d @@), or emptyLabel when nothing changed.

parts.name: line
parts.description: A line, with data-type ctx, add or del (unified), or a row pairing the old and new sides (split).

parts.name: lineNumber
parts.description: A line number: old and new in unified, one per side in split. Not selectable.

parts.name: sign
parts.description: +, − or a space, so additions and deletions read without color. Not selectable.

parts.name: code
parts.description: The line's text, wrapping long lines. Every cell carries its side's data-type.

parts.name: ins
parts.description: An added word: semibold with a success underline.

parts.name: del
parts.description: A deleted word: semibold and struck through.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls at the end of the header.

requirements: Every changed line has a + or − sign in text, and changed words are ins and del elements: color is never the only signal.
The counts are read as words (countsLabel); the visible +3 −2 is hidden from assistive technology.
The code stays LTR in every direction; the header around it mirrors.
Soft add and delete fills keep 4.5:1 for their text; line numbers keep 4.5:1 (--apui-text-muted).
